description: Look up a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) match by its match key. Returns full match detail: red and blue alliance team lists, final scores by alliance and component (auto, teleop, endgame, fouls), ranking points awarded, win/tie outcome, the Statbotics pre-match win probability and predicted score, and elimination flag. Match keys follow the format `<event-key>_<match-code>`, e.g. "2024flor_qm20" (qualification match 20), "2024flor_sf2m1" (semifinal 2 match 1), "2024flor_f1m3" (finals match 3). Use this to answer "who won 2024flor_qm20?", "what was the predicted vs actual score?", or to get alliance compositions for a known match. For browsing many matches, use get_matches.
name: get_match
